news.summary: Traveling from North Carolina to meet a new niece, Piquette's family faced immediate hassle when airline staff said they cover loss but not damage to the stroller. His TikTok video of the ordeal drew 2.9 million views, leading to a call from Southwest's executive office where the representative defended the limited liability policy on strollers and offered just a $200 voucher. Southwest later told USA TODAY they provided $500 reimbursement too, but Piquette vows never to fly with them again amid widespread frustration over family travel policies.

news.hook: Taxi drivers at Kenya's busiest airports could soon face fresh per-trip charges on top of parking fees, prompting worries from operators and riders alike.
news.name: Kenya Airports Propose New Taxi and Ride-Hailing Fees Up to Sh250 Per Trip
news.summary: The Kenya Airports Authority's draft order sets fees from Sh25 at smaller airports to Sh250 per completed trip at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for taxis and ride-hailing services like Uber and Bolt, separate from higher parking rates and annual permits up to Sh250,000. KAA says the updates, first revised since 1996, will cover rising costs and match market rates, with public forums set for November 24 in Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, and Eldoret. Critics argue operators will pass costs to passengers, adding to stacked fees without fixes like better public transit, and question revenue use amid living cost pressures.
